title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
abstract: arXiv:2611.22161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationB

translated_title: 专家构建任务上的强化学习教会了 Nemotron 3.5 Super 什么
translated_abstract: 我们对 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Super（总参数量 120B，激活参数 12B）进行强化学习（RL）后训练，使用五个专家构建的任务数据集，每次训练一个：真实世界软件工程、复杂约束、长程工具使用、专业图表理解和企业文档推理。每次运行都在 Tinker 上使用 CISPO 训练一个全新的 rank-32 LoRA 适配器，不设监督学习阶段，并在相同的任务、测试框架和设置下将每个适配器与基础模型进行比较。在十二个主要基准测试上（其中八个由其他团队构建，四个由 Surge AI 构建），提升幅度从 IFBench 上的 +4.5 分到 GDP_pdf 上的 +13.8 分不等（后者从 10.4% 提升至 24.2%）；SWE-bench Pro V2 从 86.9% 提升至 92.1%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 63.9% 提升至 70.3%，MultiChallenge 从 58.3% 提升至 66.6%，AutomationBench 从 14.8% 提升至 27.5%，Chartography 从 39.4% 提升至 50.6%。文档适配器在没有 API 工具的情况下训练，也在 AutomationBench 上获得了 +8.0 分的提升。
tldr: 通过在五个专家构建的任务数据集上分别进行无监督阶段的强化学习后训练，NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super 在十二项基准测试上取得了最高 +13.8 分的显著性能提升。
en_tdlr: Post-training NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super with reinforcement learning, one expert-built task dataset at a time and without any supervised stage, yields gains of up to +13.8 points across twelve benchmarks.
